name: Alexston Farmstead
summary: Wild Harvest Watchers prowl the ruined fields at Alexston Farmstead. Baros Alexston grew up here before becoming Stormwind's city architect.

sections.title: A Fallen Homestead
sections.body: You find Alexston Farmstead among Westfall's dry plains, abandoned like the neighboring estates. Its caretakers fled as banditry spread across the countryside. The fields have gone wild, and Harvest Watchers left to tend the crops now attack anyone near the barren farmhouse.

sections.title: Humble Roots
sections.body: Baros Alexston worked these fields in his youth, then left to pursue masonry and construction. He became one of Stormwind's most prominent citizens and helped design parts of the rebuilt capital. Something from his early life remains among the ruins.

faq.answer: The Alexston family gives the farmstead its name. Baros Alexston worked this land as a boy before moving to Stormwind to pursue architecture.
Like much of Westfall, the farmstead was abandoned after widespread unrest and Defias Brotherhood banditry. Unable to protect them, the kingdom left farmers to flee and the homestead to decay.

faq.q: Why are mechanical scarecrows attacking people here?
faq.answer: The Harvest Watchers were built to work the soil and guard crops from scavengers. When the farmers fled, the machines went without maintenance and their clockwork failed. Now they attack living creatures.

faq.q: Is there anything hidden inside the farmhouse?
faq.answer: Baros Alexston left his personal compass in the farmhouse during his youth. Travelers working in Stormwind City are sometimes asked to retrieve it from the abandoned homestead.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the farm recalls the humble, hardworking beginnings of Stormwind's finest minds and the struggle to protect its borders.
